notes.title: Yag v0.11.0.0 is on the beta branch
notes.content:
Hello,

Yag v0.11.0.0 is now on the beta branch.

It brings two major features:
- voxels
- new fully 3D pawns displacement mechanism

Voxels mean terrains are now computed and can be sculpted and painted.

Presentation video:
https://youtu.be/685Ty94OfvI

Voxels are quite a riche and complex subject so there are 8 tutorials on this subject:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLqbyFLE0xcNG0BTAW-FFDgMLM7-SssuFB

Pawns displacement tutorial:
https://youtu.be/ft_46dNHJ30

Lots of screenshots:
https://imgur.com/a/vVt3Zrb

Details:
https://trello.com/b/ME8M2OMt/yag-en

For those interested, the saves used for the presentation video are available in the file sharing section of the Yag discord.

Cedric

notes.title: Yag v0.9.11.1 on beta branch
notes.content:
Hello,

Yag v0.9.11.1 is on the beta branch.
It's a huge content update:
- New major feature: a new type of dungeons (cities)
- All cities (2 medieval, 2 skyscrapers, cyberpunk, steampunk)  completely remade with this new dungeon type.
- 4 new dungeon themes:
Stump forest (standard dungeon)
Arid desert (standard dungeon)
Dwarven architecture (standard dungeon)
Film noir (city dungeon)
- Lots of dungeons overhauled (new better ground for lots of them)
- new standad content: creatures, robots, effects
- new minor comfort features
- bug fixes

Video:
https://youtu.be/mXP8ksXH0yM 

Tutorial video for the new dungeon type:
https://youtu.be/hc-qi7ucvGM

notes.title: Yag v0.9.9.6 moved on the main branch
notes.content:
Hello,

Yag v0.9.9.6 has been moved on the main branch.
It brings all the features from v0.9.6.1 to v0.9.9.6:
- In game video cameras
- Content management through free DLCs
- Color filters
- Various sky textures
- Natural terrains
- Colors in the journal texts
- Multistory pawns displacement
- Content from different universes (medfan, modern, post apo, cyberpunk, steampunk, sci fi)
- Many more minor features
- Major code rewriting
- A ton of bug fixes

Adding all the DLCs, Yag currently offers around 50 Go of free content.

Cheers
Cedric

notes.title: v0.8.4.3 on beta branch
notes.content:
V0.8.4.3 is out on the beta branch.
As always, i'll put it on the main branch when i've enough positive feedbacks from the beta.

It brings a bit of new content and a lot of improvements in the UI.
- a few new weapons
- trays can be mouse dragged
- new copy of the journal and list of CS on the portable desk
- portable desk can be rotated to face the player
- field labels UI get new options (frame and font size)

The general presentation video:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jCnD2gpLROM

And in case you are not familiar with Steam, a small tuto about branches:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KetGu-4Y-l0

Cedric

notes.title: v0.8.4.1 on beta branch
notes.content:
v0.8.4.1 is out:
- Modules management (to distribute games/campaigns in a single zip file)
- We can now use local pictures (from the disk) as well as URLs
- Gamma correction for pictures
- LUA is now called automatically => character sheets are fully automated
- New content: a polar bear and an orc tribe

The general video presentation:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txKINZTUlmM]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txKINZTUlmM[/url]

Modules are such a huge topic that they got their tutorial video:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=or7Brhm8vyA]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=or7Brhm8vyA[/url]

As this new important version has not been tested by a lot of people yet, i put it on the beta branch.
Just in case you don't know what's a beta branch on Steam, a quick tuto here:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KetGu-4Y-l0]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KetGu-4Y-l0[/url]

I will put it on the main branch when enough feedbacks will be ok enough.
So feebacks are welcomed here:
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/736420/discussions/0/1841314700711904298/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/736420/discussions/0/1841314700711904298/[/url]

Documentation has been updated:
[url=http://yagame.fr/documentation/]http://yagame.fr/documentation/[/url]

Hope you enjoy :-)
Cheers
Cedric

notes.title: v0.8.3.4: Graphical CS with full res on main branch
notes.content:
v0.8.3.4 is now on main branch and brings two little things:
[list]
[*] Graphical character sheets are now displayed with their full resolution
[*] Flying labels adapt their size to their content
[/list]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F__ZdnRFh3A]Presentation video[/url]

Very small update, just to get rid of 2 modifications before going on with the migration from version 4.20 to 4.21 of the engine.

It's not much but it should make things a little more comfortable while waiting for the next update.

Cheers
Cedric
